crossRefs.note: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah Hezron’s wife bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

people.name: Helah
people.line: One of the two wives of Ashhur.

people.name: Naarah
people.line: Wife of Ashhur, the founder of Tekoa.

people.name: Tekoa
people.line: Town in Judah, home of the prophet Amos

translations.web: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
translations.bsb: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
translations.kjv: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
translations.asv: And Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
